definition: not in any place at all
description: A small rusty metal bus shelter with a single seat stands alone on a huge flat white salt plain that stretches away in every direction. There is no road, no bus, no building and no person anywhere, only cracked white ground, a shallow puddle reflecting the sky and a thin metal pole. Wind swirls dust across the plain and lifts a loose metal sheet on the shelter's roof, which flaps up and bangs down again. Dark mountains lie far off under heavy grey-blue clouds. The mood is lonely.

taps.phrase: to flap in the strong wind
to swirl across the salt flat
to lie on the cracked ground
